statement: Every asset shipped in this directory is listed with its own licence. Where a source recommends a credit line, that line is recorded and kept even where the licence does not compel it. Per-organ licence detail for the illustrations lives in organs/SOURCES.json, which also records each asset's view and whether it is drawn.

assets.title: Arterial System en.svg
assets.license_statement: Verified through the Wikimedia Commons API rather than the file page: imageinfo extmetadata reported License = pd, LicenseShortName = "Public domain", UsageTerms = "Public domain", and an empty Restrictions field.
assets.creator: LadyofHats (Mariana Ruiz Villarreal)
assets.recommended_credit: LadyofHats, Mariana Ruiz Villarreal, via Wikimedia Commons
modifications: Kept as native SVG with the artist's own Inkscape layers; the diagram's label text, leader arrows and hidden layer were not taken.
Both hands were repaired with minimal per-element edits on the native paths; no vessel tree was restroked and no cut edge was outlined.
The three display variants differ from the base file only in display flags, so organs can be drawn between the veins and the arteries. Every source path survives in all four files.
Coordinates are the artist's own; the renderer applies no correction transform.
Recoloured at draw time to the scene palette.
